intent: add a --dry-run flag to the export command that prints what would be written without writing it

expectations.text: export --dry-run prints the file paths that would be written and writes nothing

confirmed_findings.title: dry-run takes the export lock before it checks the flag
confirmed_findings.mechanism: export() acquires ./out/.lock at src/export.py:41 and only then branches on dry_run; when ./out is a symlink, the lock file is written into the link's target
confirmed_findings.evidence: src/export.py:41-44 — lock acquired on line 41, `if dry_run:` on line 44; the captured run had no ./out at all, so it never exercised a symlinked ./out

a.human_answer_at_FINDINGS: none — the ask is left unanswered twice

b.waiver_reason: ./out is never a symlink in our deploy layout; tracked for the next release

expected_guard: a judge-confirmed major blocks done until FINDINGS clears it by fix or a named waiver, and the record keeps the waiver, its reason and a timestamp (D2)
